name: jev-review
description: An iterative, local-first software-quality score loop for AI coding agents, powered by Jev.

interface.longDescription: Score code changes and get one-off file judgment signals with Jev. The agent diagnoses issues and makes the fixes.
defaultPrompt: Validate this change, then score its focused diff with jev_review. Diagnose weak metrics and rescore justified fixes.
Use jev_signal for one yes/no question about this file. Supply the file, answer meanings, and relevant context.
